info.name: RootBridge Sprint 3 API
info.description:
Start the backend (npm run dev) after npm run seed. Run the folders top to bottom: the login requests save tokens for the later requests.

Demo accounts (password demo123): family@demo.com (Child/Parent), learner@demo.com (Normal), teacher@demo.com (Teacher).

exec: const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('token', b.token);
const b = pm.response.json(); if (b.token) pm.collectionVariables.set('familyToken', b.token);

request.description: Sprint 2 accepted any password. Sprint 3 must refuse it.

item.name: Signup: Admin role no longer exists (400)

exec: pm.test('only hasPin comes back', () => { pm.expect(s.hasPin).to.eql(true); pm.expect(s.pin).to.be.undefined; });

item.name: Verify PIN as a Normal user (403)
Forgotten PIN: set a new one with the account password

exec: pm.test('no PIN, no lock', () => { pm.expect(s.hasPin).to.eql(false); pm.expect(s.requirePin).to.eql(false); });
pm.test('all 368 Nepali lessons', () => pm.expect(t.reduce((s, x) => s + x.totalLessons, 0)).to.eql(368));
pm.test('XP is worked out by the server', () => pm.expect(d.xp).to.be.at.most(d.completedLessons.length * 20 + d.masteredModules.length * 100));

item.name: A photo must be a real image (400)
Review of a lesson you have not finished (400)

request.description: A heart can only be earned by practising a lesson you already finished.

item.name: Finish the module quest: refill to 7
Lose one, then earn it back with a review

exec: pm.test('says where the grade came from', () => pm.expect(['coach','local']).to.include(pm.response.json().data.source));

request.description: With GEMINI_API_KEY set, the AI coach grades it; without it, the strict local check does.

item.name: Teacher: create a class (saves classId + classCode)

exec: pm.test('family shows the child name', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.students.map(s => s.name)).to.include('Aarav'));

item.name: Learner: my classes (live link, homework, materials)
Teacher: list the class in the directory
Learner: find classes without a code

exec: pm.test('the class is listed', () => pm.expect(c.name).to.eql('Saturday Nepali'));
pm.test('the join code is never listed', () => pm.expect(c.code).to.be.undefined);
pm.test('the learner message is there', () => pm.expect(r.message).to.contain('learning Nepali'));
